description: Bid a CPM against a slot. The broker evaluates it against floor_cpm_usd (the hard floor) and the authorized discount band, then auto-accepts (returning a spendable quote_id), counters with a price, or rejects. Bid at or above min_acceptable_cpm_usd from check_neuron_inventory or a prior response to be accepted; no bid is ever accepted below floor_cpm_usd.

tender_id.description: Optional. Bid on a specific flagship event from list_open_tenders. Event floors are higher than the base rate, so omitting this judges the bid against base pricing.

name: submit_programmatic_bid
